Name: L_Brow
Description: Will create a local Brows rig

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Will create a local Brows rig. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only). CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). GameMode: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl, Spine_End_Jnt. Template attrs-position examples: L_Brow_Ctrl, Vis_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl.
